unauthenticated.description: Tollgate credential probe (the `tollgate auth_status` method), callable WITHOUT a session. The admin board asks two things of this one probe before it renders a login form: whether the router has a usable root credential (it refuses to run against an unset/empty root hash, because rpcd's rpc_login_test_password() accepts ANY password while the shadow hash is empty), and whether that credential is PROVISIONAL — i.e. the install-time marker /etc/tollgate/admin-credential-provisional stands, meaning the password was generated rather than chosen, so the board forces the owner to pick their own before it becomes usable. Exposes the credential STATE only — never a hash, never a password, never the marker's text — and grants nothing else: no write and no list access for a caller with no session.
